tagline: 理光数码相机，2010 年发布
description: 理光于2010年推出的数码相机。配备f=5-25mm (like 28-140mm for 35mm film)。

specs.闪光灯: built-in automatic electronic flash. Flash range up to 10 m for wide-angle and 6.2 m for telephoto.
specs.尺寸: 118.8 mm (W) x 71.0 mm (H) x 41.0 mm (D) (excluding projecting parts).
specs.重量: Approx. 280g (excluding battery, SD memory card, strap).
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh G700SE was introduced by Ricoh in 2010.
